metas.name: Childrens Hospital
metas.description: A hospital isn't a place for lazy people. It's a place for smart people who take care of people who aren't smart enough to keep themselves healthy. So begins Children's Hospital, a parody series that follows the lives, loves and laughs of a hospital staff.

metas.name: NTSF:SD:SUV::
metas.description: NTSF:SD:SUV:: – meaning National Terrorism Strike Force: San Diego: Sport Utility Vehicle:: – is a quarter-hour format American television comedy that parodies the police procedural and action film genres.

metas.name: Dream Corp LLC
metas.description: Helmed by the easily distracted Dr. Roberts, a psychotherapeutic facility treats patients with troubling dreams. Roberts employs a team of incompetent scientists to help analyze and record those thoughts plaguing the doctor's patients.

metas.name: Three Busy Debras
metas.description: Debra, Debra, and Debra are three very busy women who are all named Debra. They live in the affluent suburb of Lemoncurd and do lots of interesting activities, which keep them very busy.

metas.name: The Eric Andre Show
metas.description: A comedic talk show from an alternate reality featuring unstable hosts, a variety of celebrities—both real and fake—and unusual studio action.

metas.name: Joe Pera Talks With You
metas.description: A teacher in Michigan's Upper Peninsula explores subject matters such as pancakes, blueberries, eggs, toast, sausage, bacon, English muffins, coffee, orange juice, maple syrup, waffles, cornbread, and strawberries.

metas.name: Your Pretty Face Is Going to Hell
metas.description: A live-action workplace comedy about Gary, an associate demon, as he attempts to capture souls on earth in order to climb the corporate ladder of the underworld. Gary hopes to advance in Hell, but he may be too stupid, lazy and kind-hearted to realize his dreams of promotion. Meanwhile, Gary's intern Claude is more talented, more devious and will do whatever it takes to impress Satan.

metas.name: Eagleheart
metas.description: Eagleheart is an action-comedy television series that premiered on February 3, 2011, on Adult Swim.

metas.name: Black Jesus
metas.description: A TV series finds Jesus living in present day Compton, CA on a daily mission to spread love and kindness throughout the neighborhood with the help of his small but loyal group of downtrodden followers.

metas.name: Delocated
metas.description: A man in the Witness Protection Program moves his family to New York City so they exploit the situation by starring in a reality tv show.

metas.name: Neon Joe, Werewolf Hunter
metas.description: Set in the pretend sleepy enclave of Garrity, Vermont, Neon Joe, Werewolf Hunter is the story of a neon-clad man with a mysterious past and a highly specialized skill set - hunting werewolves.

metas.name: Fat Guy Stuck in Internet
metas.description: Computer programmer Ken Gemberling – the titular "Fat Guy" – is accidentally sucked into his computer and learns he is destined to save cyberspace from a variety of evils.

metas.name: Tropical Cop Tales
metas.description: Two burned-out city cops -- Keymarion "Primetime" Weeyums and Demetrius "Meechie" Franks -- relocate to a tropical paradise for a relaxing twilight to their careers. It ends up being the most vicious, menacing place on earth, not even slightly relaxing.

metas.name: The Heart, She Holler
metas.description: When "Boss" Hoss Heartshe dies, he bequeaths his town to his long-hidden and dim-witted son Hurlan, who has just been introduced to human society. Thus begins the bizarre and horrifying saga of Heartshe Holler.

metas.name: Saul of the Mole Men
metas.description: Saul of the Mole Men is a live-action show created by Craig Lewis. The series first aired February 11, 2007 on Adult Swim. Described as "an ultra-patriotic Land of the Lost set in the center of the Earth", the series is directed by Tom Stern and stars Josh Gardner. Gardner is known for his previous collaboration with Stern on the television series, Gerhard Reinke's Wanderlust. The show's theme…

metas.name: Loiter Squad
metas.description: Loiter Squad is an American sketch comedy television series starring Tyler, The Creator, Jasper Dolphin, Taco Bennett, and Lionel Boyce from the Los Angeles hip hop group Odd Future. The show regularly features other members of the group as well. Jeff Tremaine, Shanna Zablow, Dimitry Elyashkevich, Lance Bangs, Nick Weidenfeld and Keith Crofford are the show's executive producers. The show is…

metas.name: Million Dollar Extreme Presents: World Peace
metas.description: Million Dollar Extreme Presents: World Peace, a satiric vision largely set in a post-apocalyptic world. The popular sketch group is comprised of Sam Hyde, Charls Carroll, and Nick Rochefort.

metas.name: The Greatest Event in Television History
metas.description: Adam Scott is determined to make the greatest event in television history by remaking the opening sequences of TV shows.

metas.name: Hot Package
metas.description: Entertainment news set in a parallel universe and featuring clips of the dark alleyways of the television landscape.

metas.name: You're Whole
metas.description: Michael Ian Black stars as Randall Tyree Mandersohn, a volleyball-obsessed self-help guru selling his 27-DVD program, which aims to help people improve their lives.  You're Whole is presented as a parody of self-help infomercials. Each episode is advertised as part of the larger DVD set.

metas.name: Mostly 4 Millennials
metas.description: Millennial hero Derrick Beckles hosts the show millennials want to watch!

metas.name: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
metas.description: A very scared man navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes, exploring fears that are both deeply personal and strikingly universal.

metas.name: The Restless Bell
metas.description: A parody of high school dramas.
